abstractEnglish: We resolve the symmetric Mahler conjecture positively, including its equality classification. Every origin-symmetric convex body in ℝn has volume product at least $`4^n/n!`$, with equality exactly for invertible linear images of Hanner polytopes.
titleEn: The symmetric Mahler conjecture and its equality cases
titleZh: 对称 Mahler 猜想及其等号情形

details.overview: 稿件声称正面解决对称 Mahler 猜想并完成等号分类：任意原点对称凸体在 R^n 中的体积积至少为 4^n/n!，等号恰在 Hanner 多面体的可逆线性像处取得。摘要只给出结论与等号刻画，未展开证明。该结果针对凸几何中对称体积积的经典猜想，作者声称同时给出下界与等号情形。
keyPoints: 声称原点对称凸体体积积下界为 4^n/n!
等号恰为 Hanner 多面体的可逆线性像
